description: Tavuk Sis Chicken Skewers are a beloved Turkish classic, featuring succulent pieces of chicken marinated in a flavorful blend of yogurt, olive oil, and aromatic spices. Grilled to perfection, these skewers offer a delightful balance of tender meat and a smoky, tangy taste. It is a must-try dish that brings the vibrant flavors of Turkish cuisine straight to your home.

ingredients.notes: mixed colors, cut into 1.5 inch pieces

instructions.title: Prepare the Chicken
instructions.text: In a large bowl, combine the cubed chicken breast.

instructions.title: Make the Marinade
instructions.text: Add yogurt, olive oil, tomato paste, minced garlic, paprika, oregano, cumin, red pepper flakes, salt, black pepper, and lemon juice to the bowl with the chicken. Mix thoroughly until all chicken pieces are well coated.

instructions.title: Marinate the Chicken
instructions.text: Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or preferably overnight, to allow the flavors to penetrate the chicken. This is crucial for tenderness and taste.

instructions.title: Assemble the Skewers
instructions.text: If using wooden skewers, ensure they have been soaked. Thread the marinated chicken pieces onto the skewers, alternating with bell peppers and red onion pieces. Do not overcrowd the skewers.

instructions.title: Preheat Grill and Cook
instructions.text: Preheat your grill to medium-high heat. Lightly oil the grates. Place the skewers on the hot grill and cook for 15-20 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through and has nice char marks. Ensure internal temperature reaches 165F (74C).

instructions.title: Serve Hot
instructions.text: Remove the Tavuk Sis from the grill and let them rest for a few minutes before serving. Garnish with fresh parsley if desired.

instructions.title: Optional Side Dishes
instructions.text: Serve your delicious Tavuk Sis with a side of traditional Turkish rice pilaf, a fresh shepherd's salad (Çoban Salata), or warm pita bread.

tips: For the most tender and flavorful Tavuk Sis, marinate the chicken for a minimum of 4 hours, or ideally overnight. The yogurt helps to tenderize the meat.
Do not overcrowd the skewers; leave a little space between the chicken and vegetables for even cooking and charring.
Serve Tavuk Sis immediately after grilling to enjoy its juicy texture and smoky flavor. It pairs wonderfully with a fresh salad and a dollop of cooling cacik.
